title: Investor Update and Board Prep — September
description: Leadership aligns on metrics, narrative, risks and asks for the September board meeting and investor update.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Morning, everyone. The board meeting is September 17th, and the investor update goes out Friday the 11th. Today I want to align on the story and the numbers.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: My headline is: growth is healthy, we're about to launch the product that unlocks the next stage, and we're capital efficient.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Fair headline, as long as the numbers back it. Let me walk through the metrics.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: And can we agree up front that we show the bad news plainly? Boards punish surprises more than misses.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Agreed. No surprises.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: ARR closed August at 4.2 million dollars, up from 3.1 million at the start of the year. That's 35 percent growth in eight months.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: And net revenue retention?

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: 118 percent trailing twelve months. Gross retention is 91.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: So we lost about nine percent. Where did that come from?

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Mostly two mid-market accounts that churned in July, together about 140 thousand dollars of ARR. One was acquired, the other cut analytics tooling entirely.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: I want to show that. I'd rather the board hear it from the update than from a question.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Agreed, but I'd frame it with the reasons. An acquisition isn't a product failure.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Right, I'll include a churn reason table. Burn is 310 thousand a month and cash is 6.8 million, so about 22 months of runway.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Should we show 22 months, or the 26 months we'd have if we held hiring flat?

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Show 22. It includes the planned hires, and it's the honest number.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Fine. We go with 22.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: On customers, the big news is Brightpath Health. They signed last week at 96 thousand dollars in annual contract value, our first healthcare logo and our largest new logo of the year.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: That's the vertical story. Helena, how do we present it?

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: As proof we can sell into regulated industries. One caveat: they aren't live yet. Kickoff is planned for early October after their change freeze, and we should say that in the update.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Q4 pipeline is at 1.9 million unweighted and about 620 thousand weighted, against a Q4 new ARR target of 260 thousand. That's 2.4 times coverage.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Good. What's driving the pipeline?

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Outbound into e-commerce and a four-webinar series we're planning for Q4. I'm taking the plan to Fatima on the 25th.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Nadia, product.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Insights 2.0 launches October 21st. That's the funnel builder rewrite, anomaly alerts, and SQL export. We have 14 design partners in the beta and an NPS of 52.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Is the date safe? Last quarter the funnel builder slipped a month.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Safe but not guaranteed. The riskiest piece is anomaly alerts, which depend on ingestion capacity. Tobias has a view.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: We're doing capacity work in September, mostly rate limiting and better isolation across tenants. We hit hot partitions in the spring, and I don't want that to repeat at launch. I'd say October 21st with a possible one-week slip.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: I'll put October 21st in the update and call it targeted.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Please do. I'd rather under-promise.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Hiring. Where are we on the senior backend role?

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: We've been looking since June, and two finalists fell through on compensation. I have six new candidates, and the first onsite is next week.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Headcount is 38 now, with 44 planned by year end.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: I want to be honest that this hire is a risk to the roadmap.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: It is. Without it, Kenji and Imani carry ingestion.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Then we say so. Now the asks: intros to healthcare-focused investors and customers, and advice on Series A timing.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: I'd say we plan to open Series A conversations in Q1, after launch metrics are in.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Agreed. Launch metrics make a better story than projections.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Risks I'll list: ingestion capacity, the backend hire, and customer concentration. Our top three customers are about 31 percent of ARR.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: I'll confirm the exact concentration figure before it goes out.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: Next steps. Fatima, can you send me the metrics and churn tables by Friday?

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Yes, I'll send the final metrics tables and the churn table by Friday.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: I'll write the product section, one page with the roadmap and launch date, by Tuesday.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: I'll draft the customer and pipeline section, including the Brightpath paragraph, by Tuesday too.

transcript.speaker: tobias
transcript.text: I'll write the capacity and hiring risk paragraph by Tuesday.

transcript.speaker: ben
transcript.text: And I'll assemble the draft and circulate it on Wednesday, so we have two days to edit before it goes out.

summary.overview: Leadership prepared the September 17th board meeting and the investor update going out on the 11th. They reviewed 4.2 million dollars of ARR, 118% net revenue retention, 22 months of runway, and two July churns worth about 140 thousand dollars. Brightpath Health was highlighted as the first healthcare logo at 96 thousand dollars ACV, and Insights 2.0 was framed as targeted for October 21st with a possible one-week slip because of ingestion capacity. The team also flagged the unfilled senior backend role and customer concentration as risks, and chose Series A timing and healthcare intros as the asks.
